fields.name: header

type.name: CommandHeader
type.doc: Shared by every command, as its first field. Replaces the type and version fields repeated per record; the record name is the type.

fields.name: commandId
fields.doc: Identity of this command, unique per order. The lifecycle commands are refused as duplicates when their id was already applied.

fields.name: correlationId
fields.doc: The root order this command belongs to.

fields.name: causationId
fields.doc: The event that caused it, as orderId:eventId.

fields.name: sentAt
fields.doc: When the producer sent it.

fields.name: producer
fields.doc: Service name, for diagnosis.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: Command API version.
Identity, causality and origin of this command.

fields.name: execution

type.name: Execution
type.doc: An execution (fill) against an order, published on the executions topic.

fields.name: execId
fields.doc: Execution identifier, unique per order.

fields.name: orderId
fields.doc: The order this execution filled.

fields.name: lastQty
fields.doc: Quantity filled by this execution. Scale 4 to match the OMS quantity scale.

fields.name: lastPx
fields.doc: Price of this execution.

fields.name: cumQty
fields.doc: Order's cumulative executed quantity after this execution.

fields.name: leavesQty
fields.doc: Order's remaining open quantity after this execution.

fields.name: avgPx
fields.doc: Average price across the order's fills. Not currently computed by oms-core; always null until it is.

fields.name: execType
fields.doc: Execution type.

fields.name: lastMkt
fields.doc: Market of execution.

fields.name: lastCapacity
fields.doc: Capacity in which the execution was made.

fields.name: transactTime
fields.doc: Time of the execution.

fields.name: rootOrderId
fields.doc: Root of the order's tree; the order's own id when it has no root. The record's Kafka key.

fields.name: orderVersion
fields.doc: The order's event-log version this fill produced (order_events.version).
The fill to apply.
